18.t: Working with data: lamps in series
q: Calculate the voltage per lamp with 2 lamps.
Calculate the total resistance with 1 and with 4 lamps.
Four lamps give 30 Ω, not 4 × 12 = 48 Ω. Explain why.
With less current each filament is cooler, so each lamp has a lower resistance than when it was alone (7.5 instead of 12 Ω).
Give one disadvantage of series circuits for house lights.
If one lamp breaks, all go out; and each lamp gets less voltage, so they are dimmer.
